title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-mar-2026-asha-personal-notes
content:
Meeting: Cross-functional roadmap alignment (Product + Eng + Applied ML) - prep notes
Date: 2026-03-04 (weekly sync)
Owner: Asha Patel (notes / facilitator)
Attendees (expected): Priya (Product PM), Jordan (Serving runtime eng), Miguel (Applied ML), Sam (Console), Mei (SRE - optional)
Goal: make sure Q2 priorities across product-hosted-api, serving runtime, and applied-ml are aligned, identify blockers for model rollouts and evaluation gates, confirm A/B rollout plan for quantized variants, and capture clear action items.

Agenda draft (15-20 min):
- Quick status (3 min): key wins/blocks from each team
- Roadmap alignment (8-10 min): finalize top-3 priorities that must ship in Q2 to support Dedicated and Private pilots
- Evals & quality gates (3 min): define minimum eval pass criteria and owners
- Rollout + infra dependencies (3-4 min): autoscaling, kernel support, monitoring hooks
- Actions & next steps (2 min)

Prep notes / talking points
1) Product ask (Priya) -- target customer scenarios to unblock:
   - Dedicated customers need predictable latency at 99th pct for 2048 tokens workload. Current benchmark: 95th pct ~220ms on p4d for kv-cache warm path (Jordan to confirm latest numbers).
   - Private deployment: KMS integration + audit logs required before pilot. Tracking JIRA-RDW-1421.
   - Proposed priority: 1) 99p latency improvements for 2k seq length, 2) rollout guardrails for quantized models, 3) console UX for per-route cost breakdown.

2) Serving/runtime (Jordan) -- risks & constraints
   - Kernel parity gap for int8 kernels on A100 vs H100 for new LLM family (affects quantized path). Need kernel vendor patch or fallback which increases latency ~15%.
   - Continuous batching improvements are behind by 2 sprints (blocker for throughput targets).
   - Need final decision on default fallback policy: prefer lower-latency variant vs cheaper variant? (product decision)

3) Applied ML (Miguel) -- model & eval needs
   - We have 3 candidate open models for catalog: v1 (fast), v2 (higher-quality), v2-quant (smaller). Need evaluation harness on production prompts (sample set) to measure quality regression after quantization.
   - Proposal: run quality-focused eval set + user-facing metrics for a canary before rollouts. Threshold: <3% drop in helpfulness score across prompts (Priya to confirm metric).

Data points to surface in meeting
- Current 99p latency baseline (p4d) for 2k sequences: Jordan to provide number (ACTION: Jordan, by 2026-03-03).
- Token cost delta: float vs int8 measured on H100 (Miguel to supply rough numbers).
- Existing customer commitments: Dedicated pilot for FinCorp in May; Private pilot NDA with HealthCo in June (Sam to confirm dates).

Decisions needed in sync
- Default fallback policy: latency-first or cost-first? (Product decision; impacts runtime routing)
- Quantized model rollout policy: require full eval pass + staged canary (yes/no)
- Can we commit to per-route cost telemetry changes in console by end of Q2? (Console team input)

Open questions / notes to self
- Are there any compliance blockers for shipping Private pilot given KMS/HSM timelines? Who owns remediation for audit logs? (Sam?)
- If kernel vendor patch slips, fallback adds 15% latency — does that break SLA for Dedicated? Need simulation.
- How many prompts in the eval harness are sufficient for statistical confidence? 300? 1k? Miguel to propose sample plan.

Action items (clear, owner, due)
- Jordan: supply updated latency baseline numbers (50/90/99 pct) for 512/1024/2048 seq lengths; attach perf graphs to Confluence page. Due: 2026-03-03.
- Miguel: run preliminary quantization quality eval on candidate v2-quant using the agreed prompt set; share delta in helpfulness and toxicity. Due: 2026-03-06.
- Priya: confirm product priority list (top-3) and articulate customer-facing success criteria for each. Due: 2026-03-05.
- Sam (Console): feasibility check on per-route cost telemetry UI + rough ETA for an initial beta. Due: 2026-03-10.
- Asha (me): consolidate meeting notes, update Confluence roadmap draft with agreed decisions and link to JIRA tickets. Due: 2026-03-05.
- Miguel + Jordan: simulation of fallback latency impact on Dedicated SLA; produce short risk memo. Due: 2026-03-08.

Post-meeting follow-up items (if we green-light rollout)
- Create canary plan: percentage rollout, rollback triggers (latency spikes, quality regression thresholds), monitoring dashboards. Owner: Priya + SRE. Due: 2026-03-15 (draft).
- Eval harness integration into CI: short-term: nightly job running quantization checks on sample prompts; long-term: integrate into pre-rollout gating. Owner: Miguel + Release Eng. Due: 2026-04-01.

Notes / fragments to remember (informal)
- Keep list of impacted customers for communication (FinCorp healthco etc.)
- Mention A/B variant naming scheme to avoid confusion in telemetry: use model:tag (e.g., llama2-13b-v2-quant).
- Check PR #402 for runtime batching improvements; may change perf numbers (linked).

Potential friction areas to raise explicitly in meeting
- Prioritization tension: product wants latency + console features; eng needs time to land kernel fixes; applied-ml needs more validation time for quantized variants.
- Resource limits: dedicated GPU pool availability in April could constrain canary throughput.

Final quick checklist before sync
- [ ] Attach perf graphs + Jupyter snippets (Jordan)
- [ ] Preliminary eval results or plan (Miguel)
- [ ] Confirm customer pilot dates (Sam)
- [ ] Send agenda + pre-reads to attendees by EOD prior to meeting (Asha)

Personal note: keep the meeting tight (15-20m). Push unresolved deep technicals to follow-ups with smaller working group (Jordan + Miguel + infra).
